selection.edition: international Brex Team and Transactions API
selection.ownership: Brex Inc. (United States). First-party developer API at api.brex.com. Capital One closed a 2026 acquisition of Brex; the product remains a US/global finance API, not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official Brex authentication (dashboard user tokens as Authorization Bearer, distinct from partner OAuth), GET /v2/users/me, GET /v2/company, GET /v2/users, GET /v2/accounts/card, Brex Inc. US identity, and dated incident search (Brex + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying platform incident found in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim. OpenAPI labels the security scheme OAuth2, but first-party user tokens are documented and are not an invented API-key mapping.
